_comment: Sample team presets. main.py currently spins up 'Home FC' (user-managed, side HOME) vs 'Away United' (AI, side AWAY) each session via src/agents/team.py:build_team, which procedurally generates rosters from data/players.json's archetypes with a seeded RNG. This file lists alternative club presets that could be selected from in a future team-picker menu.
